columns.name: LDAP_USER_ID
columns.description: Mandatory primary key updatable while new key generation

columns.name: BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: LDAP_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to LDAP request. Mandatory. Updatable while new mandatory FK association.

columns.name: REQUEST_TYPE
columns.description: The type of request to perform: CREATE, UPDATE, SUSPEND, ACTIVATE

columns.name: REQUEST_STATUS
columns.description: The current status of the user portion of the request: REQUEST, IN PROGRESS, COMPLETE

columns.name: USER_GUID
columns.description: The user Guid of the user the request is for (if available)

columns.name: USERNAME
columns.description: The username of the user the request is for (if not auto generated)

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUESTOR_USER_GUID
columns.description: The user Guid of the user who is making the LDAP request (if available)

columns.name: PREFERRED_LANGUAGE
columns.description: The preferred language of the user the request is for. Default taken if not provided.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEND_CREDENTIALS_EMAIL
columns.description: Indicates whether credential emails will be sent for the user

columns.name: CREDENTIALS_EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: Set this column If you want to send the credentials email to another email address
